provider: Smithsonian Institution Global Volcanism Program / U.S. Geological Survey Volcano Hazards Program
dataset: Smithsonian / USGS Weekly Volcanic Activity Report (RSS)
description: Weekly summary of volcanoes with new or continuing eruptive activity worldwide, compiled from volcano observatories, VAACs and other reports; one item per volcano and report week.

coverage.temporal: The most recent report week (Wednesday to Tuesday); earlier weeks persist locally until retention expires.

updateCadence.upstream: Weekly, by 2300 UTC every Thursday (publication is occasionally paused)

attribution: Global Volcanism Program, Smithsonian Institution / U.S. Geological Survey – Weekly Volcanic Activity Report

license.name: © Smithsonian Institution – Smithsonian Terms of Use (usage conditions apply; non-commercial use)
license.notes: The feed declares <copyright>Smithsonian Institution</copyright>. Smithsonian content not marked CC0 may be used for personal, educational and other non-commercial purposes; commercial use needs permission. The Smithsonian terms page is behind a browser verification challenge and could not be read directly when this adapter was written (finding based on search-engine excerpts) – re-check before commercial use. This application therefore shows only the item title, an excerpt of at most 500 characters and a link to the full report at volcano.si.edu; report texts are not stored or redistributed in full.

limitations: Not a comprehensive list of eruptions: only activity that meets the report's criteria in a given week is included.
Notices are preliminary and subject to change; they summarise reports of other agencies, which are named in each item.
Published once a week, so activity can be up to a week old when it appears, and publication is sometimes paused (when captured on 2026-11-10 the feed still carried the report for 8–14 October 2026).
Only a short excerpt is shown; alert levels mentioned in the text are those of the national observatories and are not normalised.
confidenceNotes: The report gives no confidence or severity value, so records carry neither. The report section ('New Eruptive Activity' or 'Continuing Eruptive Activity') is kept as the sub-category.

retention.note: Weekly items are kept for 60 days after the end of their report week.

layers.name: Weekly volcanic activity (GVP/USGS)
layers.description: Volcanoes with new or continuing eruptive activity in the latest Smithsonian / USGS Weekly Volcanic Activity Report, with a short excerpt and a link to the report.
